notes.title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver- is now on Steam!
notes.content:
FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver- is finally here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26005076/c26b1067b8ccebc6e355fc278ae4dc059cfe893d.png[/img]

As the leaves turn and strange incidents continue to plague the isolated Saint Angraecum Academy, interweaving threads of emotion tangle together in an intricate story of love and truth.

Continue the story in the third visually stunning game of the Flowers visual novel series from Innocent Grey. It will capture your heart with its complex characters, beautiful artwork, memorable soundtrack, and engaging story. As you unravel the story, your decisions will shape the outcome.

We look forward to hearing about your thoughts on Flowers -Le volume sur automne-. Thank you all for your support and we hope you enjoy playing!

notes.title: Flowers -Le volume sur automne- Release Date Announced
notes.content:
The release day of the third chapter in the amazing Innocent Grey yuri series has finally been announced. You can expect Flowers -Le volume sur automne- later this month on July 30th, 2020, on the Steam platform.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238730/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_automne/

As the summer heat fades, Suoh Shirahane is just one step away from unraveling the mystery of why her beloved Amitie partner left in the spring.

Yuzuriha Yatsushiro, president of the school’s Council of Nicaea, knows the truth hidden within the school. The silver-haired beauty seeks to prevent Suoh from reaching it by giving her what seems like an impossible task — take over the role of president and she’ll hand over the key to what she desires.

However, Yuzuriha is harboring her own secret, buried deep within herself…

As the leaves turn and strange incidents continue to plague the isolated Saint Angraecum Academy, interweaving threads of emotion tangle together in an intricate story of love and truth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38308816/d918d029eb65ab11905c1966964d6683c7886c1e.jpg[/img]

Don't forget to wishlist and we hope that you enjoy the next chapter of this amazing Visual Novel series.

- JAST USA Team
